notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Daxos and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
